purpose: Expand evidence-based SOC triage, multi-source investigation, timeline reconstruction and uncertainty handling beyond CTI technique mapping.
evidence_scope: Primary provider pages and bounded metadata checked now; previous acquisition and use taken from SOURCE_EXPANSION.json, V4_DATA_PREPARATION.json and V5_DATA_PREPARATION.json. Archive availability/content not tested now.

candidates.nature: De-identified internal network logs with designated red-team authentication events; not a complete incident-response answer set.
candidates.ground_truth: redteam.txt.gz lists selected known compromise authentication events; unlisted events are not certified benign.
candidates.rights: Provider page waives copyright and related rights to the extent possible under law; retain academic citation.
candidates.selection: Start with red-team metadata; pair selected host/time windows with authentication, process, DNS and flow records. Request form and download access not exercised. Single gzip files may require server-side streaming of substantial bytes; URL references alone do not train weights.
limitations: Anonymized relative epoch cannot be converted to factual KST dates.
Older environment and incomplete malicious-event labels.
Event count is not independent incident or dialogue count.

candidates.provider: DARPA-funded OpTC; collected/enriched by Five Directions, with Boston Fusion, BAE and Provatek roles described by provider
candidates.nature: Isolated Windows testbed with background activity and red-team injection; not real production incidents.
candidates.ground_truth: OpTCRedTeamGroundTruth.pdf and eCAR/Bro linkage; provider errata must be applied.
candidates.rights: Provider README states public-domain release and Distribution A; no accuracy warranty.
candidates.selection: Read ground-truth report and errata first; choose campaign/host/day files on provider Drive. Do not fetch the full corpus. Download availability not verified.
limitations: Duplicate process objects, missing module-load hashes, zero acuity values and inconsistent path representations.
Do not attribute release to an unverified MITLL repository.
No complete approved-action or rollback ground truth.

candidates.nature: Provider-created SOC/CTF scenarios including cloud and APT investigation.
candidates.ground_truth: Official release announcement offers questions, answers and hints by email request; not obtained here.
candidates.rights: Repository LICENSE is CC0-1.0; runtime/add-ons have separate licenses.
candidates.selection: Obtain authoritative question/answer set and verify a usable log export path before admission. No email sent or Splunk installed.
limitations: Not plain raw JSON/CSV directly usable by our MCP.
Published installation targets old versions; compatibility not validated.
Public walkthrough answers are not a substitute for provider ground truth.

candidates.provider: Carnegie Mellon University SEI/CERT with ExactData and DARPA sponsorship
candidates.nature: Institution-generated synthetic background and insider-threat activities.
candidates.ground_truth: Provider answer archive contains scenario descriptions and synthetic user identifiers; must pair with logs from matching release.
candidates.rights: CC BY 4.0 reconfirmed through official version-1 API.
candidates.selection: Reuse previously verified answer archive and checksums; choose matching release/context before server-side selective extraction.
limitations: 194 archive members are not 194 independent incidents.
Full multi-GB log archives were not acquired previously or now.
Cross-release repeated scenarios must be deduplicated before splitting.

candidates.provider: AIT Austrian Institute of Technology / TU Wien
candidates.nature: Institution-generated testbeds; ADS is derived from LDS, not independent incident evidence.
candidates.ground_truth: ADS labels are attack-phase intervals; LDS has log-line rules and labels. A phase interval does not prove every contained alert malicious.
candidates.rights: ADS CC BY 4.0; pinned LDS v2.0 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 per prior verified records. Keep them distinct and recheck chosen version on acquisition.
candidates.selection: Prioritize evidence-linked Wazuh/Suricata episodes in existing training environments; preserve historical validation/test environments and derivative-family grouping.
limitations: AIT already used in earlier training, but not latest V5 CTI core.
More rows in existing scenarios are not new independent incidents.
Cannot call historical AIT holdouts or V5 final128 newly unseen.

not_prioritized.reason: Useful reproducible attack recordings, but root README says GPL-3.0 while LICENSE says MIT; file-level provenance/licensing scope must be resolved before admission. Community source, not government certification.

Author preprint describing 106 OTRF procedures and Sigma-derived labels; useful evaluation design, but peer review/data license not confirmed and labels are not independent expert full-incident adjudication. Do not count it as independent of OTRF.

admission_rules: Preserve source URL/DOI/revision/license, exact selected content hashes, event identifiers and provider ground-truth link. Keep provider labels separate from project-derived dialogue/action labels.
Group splits by incident/campaign/environment and source derivatives, not log rows. Reserve new final cases before model responses; consumed V5 final128 cannot be fresh evaluation.
Minimize authored narratives; bind answers to source evidence. MCP names, approvals, protected addresses and rollback constraints require separate local contract tests and reviewed execution traces.
Treat evidence omission, fabricated facts, wrong target, unjustified benign decisions and unauthorized actions as critical errors; report SOC workflow performance separately from CTI F1.
Use selective files or verified range retrieval where supported. Streaming a compressed archive may still transfer most bytes. Reference links alone are not training inputs.
Provider reputation and permissive terms do not guarantee annotation correctness or quality improvement. Human/expert adjudication status must be explicit.
recommended_order: AIT evidence-linked expansion within allowed training environments
CMU CERT matching context and answers
next_required: Select independent episodes and ground-truth pairs, check license/file availability and contamination, then freeze a small development study and new final holdout before considering further training.
